items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: When Cliff passed, Ed Beach who, you know, was the WRVR -- ... records as a side man and Ed Beach had them and he played all of them

ctx.x: That's the same one where you appeared in 1956.

And then just before he passed, Fat Cat arranged for him to make an album, solo piano and it's called "Parlor Piano," I think and it came out the day that he passed. Of course this was taken later in his career. In fact he had had a couple heart attacks before that, before the album was made and he wasn't exactly up to par, as well as, you know, he would like to have been because he had been quite seriously ill. But that's the last album that he made.
